cases.name: client cannot mutate media; coach routes need coach role
photo-only: upload JPEG, crop, alt/cues, real processing, explicit review, publish (no video)
client workout shows the current photo inline; text/external fallbacks intact; bytes are the processed derivative
image abuse refused before ready: SVG, GIF, animated, truncated, dimension/pixel bombs, fake MIME; nothing stored
EXIF-rotated portrait photo: oriented facts, crop band, metadata stripped (split squat variant)
video + custom thumbnail: preview <=2 MiB silent fast-start, separate instruction, escaped captions, transcript
start/end stills from WebM (plank): frames kind with end-frame alt text
portrait MOV with audio: narrated instruction requires captions+transcript before review
video abuse refused: playlist, truncated, >120s, >60fps, extra streams, legacy codec, mismatch
ownership and IDOR matrix with real auth, PostgREST and SQL
capabilities re-authorize on every request: reassignment, archived client, replacement, expiry, tamper
replacement updates the current guide everywhere without touching prescriptions or history (image-only -> video)
publish race through the API: same expected version -> one 200, one 409
oversize source refused; worker crash mid-job: lease expires, same job resumes (attempt 2), no duplicate revision; prior current kept
failed replacement leaves the previous guide current and visible to clients
interrupted upload and staged-upload crash recovery leave no partials and no orphaned rows
committed source whose file install fails: bytes kept, same-request retry finalizes the recorded key once, then processing and client reads succeed
media lookup failure never blocks reading, editing or completing a workout
batched hydration: a 50-exercise log costs the same queries as a 7-exercise log, and no video bytes are fetched by reads
default upload limit: the 11th admitted upload in 15 minutes is refused with 429
disabled configuration: quiet discovery, 503 for every other media route and workout payloads without media fields
server and worker logs carry no capabilities, storage keys, media text, rights notes or client identities
